name: MJÖLNIR BASH
description: Wield Mjölnir to strike enemies. When Awakened, Thor can launch lightning arc waves to deal damage.

name: God of Thunder
description: Soar upwards and smite the ground after charging for a duration, inflicting damage and stunning enemies within range.

stats.CASTING: A persistent spell field that generates a one-time spell field upon expiration.
stats.DAMAGE: While charging, create a sustained spell field that deals 40 damage every 0.5 seconds, followed by a one-time spell field that deals 220 damage.
stats.RANGE: The sustained spell field is cylindrical, measuring 8m in radius and 20m in height, whereas the one-time spell field has an 8m spherical radius

name: Hammer Throw
description: Throw Mjölnir forward which then returns. Restore Thorforce upon hit.

stats.CASTING: Launch a single-target projectile that returns after a delayed hit
stats.DAMAGE: Outward Projectile Damage: 45; Returning Projectile Damage: 20
stats.PROJECTILE SPEED: The projectile travels outward at a speed of 60m/s and returns at a speed of 80m/s
stats.SPECIAL EFFECT: ⚬ Gain 1 point of Thorforce upon hit.

name: Storm Surge
description: Hold to spin Mjölnir before dashing forward and Knocking Back enemies.

stats.DASH DISTANCE: No charge: 10m; Full charge: 20m. When carrying an enemy, the ranges are 6m with no charge and 13m with full
stats.DAMAGE: No Charge Damage: 40; Full Charge Damage: 60

name: Lightning Realm
description: Summon lightning that restores Thorforce based on the number of hit enemies. Enemies leaving the Lightning Realm will suffer Slow and Grounded effects.

stats.DAMAGE: Deal 40 damage when enemies cross the boundaries

name: Awakening Rune
description: Consume Thorforce to enter the Awakened state, granting Bonus Health and enhancing Mjölnir Bash. Gain Thorforce upon exiting the state.

stats.DAMAGE: Projectile Damage: 70, Spell Field Damage: 15 per second
stats.ATTACK INTERVAL: The first three stages last for 0.4s each, while the fourth stage lasts for 0.8s

name: Thorforce
description: Consume Thorforce to gain Bonus Health. Landing Mjölnir Bash on an enemy instantly recharges Thorforce

stats.BONUS HEALTH PER THORFORCE: Each point of Thorforce consumed grants 75 Bonus Health, while abilities that consume 3 points of Thorforce grant 150 Bonus Health

name: Thunderstrike Pike
description: Angela shares fragments of her Ichors with Thor, empowering him to hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
